description: Defines a finite state machine class for managing the state of a ZeroMQ-based radio transmit channel, including state transitions, timers, and status checks.

classes.name: radio_zmq_tx_channel_fsm
classes.description: A class implementing a finite state machine to control the states of a ZeroMQ radio transmit channel, including handling start, error, request, data transmission, and stop states.

methods.name: init_successful
methods.description: Sets the state to WAIT_START after successful initialization.

methods.name: on_start
methods.description: Transitions the state to WAIT_REQUEST and starts the timer, indicating processing has started.

methods.name: on_error
methods.description: Transitions the state to STOPPED upon encountering a non-recoverable error.

methods.name: request_received
methods.description: Transitions from WAIT_REQUEST to WAIT_DATA and restarts the timer upon receiving a request.

methods.name: data_sent
methods.description: Transitions from WAIT_DATA to WAIT_REQUEST and restarts the timer after data is sent.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Transitions the state to STOPPED if the channel is currently running.

methods.name: async_task_stopped
methods.description: Sets the state to STOPPED when the asynchronous task stops.

methods.name: is_initiated
methods.description: Checks if the channel has been successfully initialized (state > UNINITIALIZED).

methods.name: is_running
methods.description: Checks if the channel is in a running state (WAIT_REQUEST or WAIT_DATA).

methods.name: has_pending_request
methods.description: Returns true if the current state is WAIT_DATA, indicating a pending request.

methods.name: has_wait_expired
methods.description: Checks if the wait timer has expired while the channel is operational, and restarts the timer if so.
